Mohit Sharma | mohit.sharma461@example.com | +91 9446528697
Hyderabad, Telangana

Professional Summary
Experienced DevOps and Cloud Engineer focused on building reliable, scalable infrastructure and automated delivery pipelines. Strong track record designing and operating containerized platforms and cloud-native services, improving deployment frequency and system availability. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Hyderabad only. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Kubernetes, Terraform, RDS, Lambda, S3, Docker, CI/CD, Jenkins, Linux, Jira, Git

Work Experience

Senior DevOps Engineer, Razorpay (Jan 2025 - Present)
- Implemented Docker-based image build standards and image scanning, reducing container vulnerability findings by 40% while maintaining CI/CD throughput using Jenkins.
- Architected CI/CD pipelines integrating Jenkins, Git, and Terraform for infrastructure provisioning on AWS, accelerating release time by 35%.
- Managed Kubernetes clusters for payment microservices, leveraging S3 for backups and RDS for stateful components, improving service reliability and failover recovery.

Site Reliability Engineer, Ledgerly (Sep 2024 - Dec 2024)
- Stabilized production services by containerizing legacy components with Docker and migrating critical workloads to Kubernetes, cutting incident frequency on core services by 25%.
- Automated deployment workflows using CI/CD practices and Git-based triggers, reducing manual release steps and deployment errors.
- Hardened Linux hosts and improved observability; collaborated via Jira to prioritize and resolve reliability issues.

Cloud Engineer, Saffron Bank (Mar 2019 - Aug 2024)
- Designed and maintained AWS infrastructure using Terraform, managing RDS instances, S3 lifecycle policies, and Lambda functions for serverless tasks.
- Containerized applications with Docker and orchestrated deployments to Kubernetes clusters; introduced CI/CD pipelines to automate builds and rollouts.
- Administered Linux environments, integrated Git for source control, and used Jenkins for automated testing and deployments, improving deployment success rate and rollback speed.

Education
